2105260950920311071.title: Lone spearman charges a burning battlefield (10s)
2105260950920311071.description: Keep one spear in the hero’s hands: no duplicates, disappearing weapons or shape changes. Requiring every enemy to move and each action to cause the next makes this a useful starting point for pole-and-tool fights.

2093988861496168653.title: Bruce Lee-style courtyard fight: FPV single take
2093988861496168653.description: Strict continuity rules ban reversals and fades, with just half a second of slow motion for the reveal. The invisible “ghost camera,” reference-image locks and near-camera strikes help keep the long take coherent.

2093199866906456471.title: A playful martial-arts kiss: a failed single take
2093199866906456471.description: The model cut to a reaction even though the prompt requested one continuous shot. “Smooth switching” between shot sizes can encourage editing; adding “No slowmotion” addressed a separate repeated failure.

2086124547376341346.title: Market brawl with bamboo poles, crates and ladders
2086124547376341346.description: Jackie Chan-style prop action breaks the fight into two-second beats with sound effects. Poles, trays, lantern strings and ladders make this a useful reference for improvised-weapon choreography.

2068834853894664445.title: Viking berserker raids a village in one take
2068834853894664445.description: Separate style, references and timeline sections make the prompt easy to follow. Repeating the tracking direction every four seconds and locking the character’s appearance helps sustain the village raid.

2060421985608597798.title: Erlang Shen vs Sun Wukong, with Chinese dialogue
2060421985608597798.description: Each deity is tied to a separate reference image ([Image1]/[Image2]), with a defined appearance and weapon: Erlang Shen’s three-pointed, double-edged blade and Sun Wukong’s Ruyi Jingu Bang. Chinese dialogue is inserted with an explicit request for English subtitles. CAMERA, LIGHTING and COLOR GRADING are separate sections; NO MUSIC leaves rain, footsteps and weapon sounds. Use the same dialogue structure for divine combat with Taiwanese Hokkien or Hakka lines.

2041772197799236033.title: Eastern dragon saves a city from a giant serpent (single take)
2041772197799236033.description: A wingless, biological dragon is defined through muscle, scales, weight and inertia. Destruction, arrival, struggle and rescue form a continuous story that can also inform mythic-spirit scenes.

2020862666290721268.title: Torchlit temple battle in retro Hong Kong wuxia style
2020862666290721268.description: Four timed beats combine camera, action and traditional instruments. The 180-degree orbit and brief drops to 60% speed give the group fight a clear rhythm under torchlight.

2009010940616769542.title: Knight rides through a burning village
2009010940616769542.description: Fire, drifting ash and fleeing villagers carry the scene rather than combat moves. A low rear tracking shot mixes firelight with dusk, making this a useful aftermath transition.

2109502196824084591.title: Vertical street fight outside a convenience store
2109502196824084591.description: A 9:16 duel uses detailed clothing descriptions to hold the two identities steady. It names categories of moves rather than scripting every strike, leaving choreography to the model.

2106931613427028260.title: Ink-wash swordsman: camera moves in degrees per second
2106931613427028260.description: Numeric angular speeds distinguish fast rotations from slow orbits. Camera, visuals and effects stay in separate columns so ink textures and particles survive the action.

2104802751435911223.title: One against many in a train carriage
2104802751435911223.description: Atmosphere and camera terms do most of the work, with negative prompts for duplicate people and extra limbs. The narrow aisle itself constrains blocking and reduces crowd confusion.

2102973186984030688.title: High-speed spear duel with identity locks
2102973186984030688.description: Four reference images separate two fighters and two spears. Explicit identity and weapon locks address merging and swapping, while the camera intercepts and dives rather than merely following.

2099006619988459985.title: Flaming sword sweeps through shadow beasts
2099006619988459985.description: A compact paragraph combines low tracking, a spinning strike, charging creatures and a shockwave. It is a quick way to test an action idea without a full timeline.

2096103896553001298.title: Twenty-second ballroom brawl in one take
2096103896553001298.description: Seven beats connect blocks, throws, a sweep, broken glass and a final exit. Named moves and repeated weight, inertia and biomechanics cues make the close combat concrete.

2095175917412962628.title: Red-haired warrior struck by an arrow (single take, millisecond timecodes)
2095175917412962628.description: MiniMax-H3’s structured format separates action and sound. The hit is broken into entry direction, a delayed collapse, dropped blades and dust, showing how to describe a convincing reaction.

2092825704480329768.title: Neon-alley single take: one blade, three robots
2092825704480329768.description: The opening locks clothes, blade, opponents and location, then forbids teleporting, resets and jump cuts. Each three-second segment gives the camera’s starting and ending direction.

2092533822592036981.title: Fallen capital: a knight rescues the heir through fire
2092533822592036981.description: Short lists cover story, setting, palette, light, camera and sound. Wide views, close fire shots and tight handheld passages make this useful for a burning-village montage.

2088369662295695610.title: Thirty-second rainy warehouse duel without blood
2088369662295695610.description: Five-second beats repeat no blood, injuries or weapons at both ends. Sound and footwork provide impact; a fist stopping short ends the scene without a knockout.

2086494563347398669.title: Lantern street duel in three hard cuts
2086494563347398669.description: Explicit shot labels assign one task to each of three shots. The final exchange names three moves before the weapons lock, making the intended editing easy to follow.

2085108054518067278.title: Supermarket cabbage vs katana: quarter-second beats
2085108054518067278.description: Very fine timing is paired with foreground layers and shutter cues. The strongest reusable idea is strict weapon ownership: each fighter keeps their own prop or blade throughout.

2082370698048414190.title: Tai chi redirection and throw in a gym
2082370698048414190.description: A list of distinct beats moves from a flying attack through redirection, a throw and recovery. One clear action per beat keeps the nine-second sequence readable.

2082035898716389382.title: White-haired dual-sword fighter vs armored samurai
2082035898716389382.description: Five storyboard panels organize a vertical fifteen-second duel. Separate character and setting descriptions precede the action, which ends as bloodless fantasy martial arts.

2073659391807803412.title: Sea monster attacks a wooden fleet at night
2073659391807803412.description: A 60:30:10 color ratio anchors darkness, bioluminescence and cannon fire. Monster physics, changing frame rates and muffled slow-motion sound shape the night battle.

2069797803899965625.title: Animated exorcist clears a temple with a sacred spear
2069797803899965625.description: Three timed sections mix characters and actions with anime camera language. Talisman-wrapped weapons and golden light offer a visual bridge to Taiwanese temple imagery.

2067298200520896673.title: Six-second running fight over rough terrain
2067298200520896673.description: A single paragraph lists kicks, knees, flips and falls while emphasizing momentum. For a short Grok Imagine clip, one continuous action chain is enough.

2059760915025699022.title: Wuxia fighter takes on a castle’s skeleton army
2059760915025699022.description: Hair, clothes and gloves are restated after each segment. Speed changes and matching sound support the fight; the camera is told to follow her rather than get ahead.

2056321432808767664.title: Flaming-sword warrior against an army of monsters
2056321432808767664.description: Four lines separate character, action, environment and camera. The camera line becomes a complete sequence, from a wide reveal to speed changes, handheld clashes and a final orbit.

2051610377306116575.title: Armored knight fights a crowd in the mud
2051610377306116575.description: Four short lines cover the essentials. Emphasizing weight and connecting clashes with whip pans are the key cues that keep the melee grounded.

2049906568909684901.title: Two armies descend into an ancient battlefield
2049906568909684901.description: The sequence moves from aerial geography to landing, charging, close clashes and a final wide melee. Style, camera and mood close the prompt; the structure can be adapted to village factions.

2048067032738930903.title: Ninja melee in a rain-soaked bamboo grove
2048067032738930903.description: A concise vertical prompt combines many fighters, bamboo, heavy rain, fog and clashing blades. It is a straightforward starting point for Grok Imagine crowd action.

2045457317953667271.title: Rainy rooftop sword duel: three models, one prompt
2045457317953667271.description: The same prompt is shown side by side in three models. Rain, blade contact in slow motion and a full orbit make useful comparison points.

2039728331826799101.title: Tiger warrior vs dragon spirit: blades, then fire
2039728331826799101.description: One sentence links the clash, a blade lock, fire and the tiger’s physical reaction. Scorched fur, a backward head movement and a dropping arm make impact feel tangible.

2034069165011833180.title: Rooftop assassins in heavy rain: Chinese timecodes
2034069165011833180.description: Each timecoded beat pairs one shot with one action. The author revised a crane instruction after an earlier version made a literal crane appear in the frame.

2033696362320240879.title: Black-clad swordswoman vs dual blades in bamboo rain
2033696362320240879.description: One Chinese keyword paragraph combines appearance, sword light, splashes and soaked fabric. Tracking, crane moves, orbiting and impact slow motion are layered onto the duel.

2033495931514179601.title: A thousand riders: grass-level tracking to aerial wide
2033495931514179601.description: Four shots are linked with cuts, crash zooms and snaps. Film references and slight handheld vibration give the cavalry charge scale and a sense of shaking ground.

2023664996987924781.title: Katana fighter cuts down robots in four scenes
2023664996987924781.description: Quality and speed instructions come first, followed by four action beats. Multiple angles cover ambushes, laser blocks and a final explosive cut.

2010908642804224203.title: Elemental sword performance in a fixed full-body shot
2010908642804224203.description: The prompt explicitly frames this as cinematic martial-arts performance. A fixed front view keeps every move in frame while fire, lightning, wind and ice add variety.

2001018030575509581.title: Bamboo-grove samurai duel: Runway 4.5 vs Kling 2.6
2001018030575509581.description: Exact seconds organize a brief exchange and final pose. High-contrast black and white with a single red accent creates a Kurosawa-inspired visual plan.

2000219951433486367.title: Animated aerial fight around a giant’s neck
2000219951433486367.description: Spiraling movement, rapid slashes and missed grabs establish scale. Split-second impact freezes and an orbiting camera help sell the fight against a much larger opponent.

1999359728283983905.title: Water samurai vs smoke dragon: an elemental stress test
1999359728283983905.description: Prompt, camera, light and key details are separated. Three numbered requirements make the expected interaction between non-solid characters explicit.

1998039564829507631.title: Warrior and wolf defend a snowy Viking village
1998039564829507631.description: Raiders emerge between houses as weapons spark and a wolf joins the fight. A broad request for dynamic camera movement leaves Veo room to interpret the defense.

1998136315343409451.title: Dojo master blocks a student one-handed, with sound cues
1998136315343409451.description: Scene, element, movement, audio and other notes have separate fields. Bracketed object-action-sound cues and a spoken line suit Kling 2.6’s native audio.

1996925385184104893.title: Morning-rush couple fight with flying coffee
1996925385184104893.description: Scene, action, audio and camera are clearly separated. Onomatopoeic hits, music style and side tracking with handheld impact shake organize the everyday-action setup.

1981632619109601542.title: Ink samurai breaks through paper: image to video
1981632619109601542.description: Action, camera, atmosphere and style each get one sentence. Since the reference already supplies appearance, the text focuses on movement and camera work.

1980612333723611356.title: Rainy street martial arts with a locked camera
1980612333723611356.description: A fixed medium-distance camera lets the fighters move while the frame stays still. Short slow-motion bursts add rhythm without complicating the camera path.

1973323214685085757.title: Knight on a burning battlefield: Midjourney video
1973323214685085757.description: The same scene used for Luma is run with Midjourney video parameters and a square frame. The original shows two versions for comparing animated-illustration movement and camera behavior.

1973119429576708138.title: Knight drags a sword across a burning battlefield
1973119429576708138.description: Low tracking follows sparks, smoke and distant fighting before the sword is raised. Another entry uses the same prompt in Midjourney, giving a direct point of comparison.

1973032611124556070.title: Hand-to-hand fight at a broken skyscraper edge
1973032611124556070.description: A shattered wall two hundred floors up supplies the danger. Falling glass and punches close to the edge show how setting can create tension without a long list of moves.

1970484324282568930.title: Sweep kick and airborne dodge in perfect timing
1970484324282568930.description: The sweep and leap happen together, with dust marking the first move. A low dolly follows the leg before tilting up to the jump, tying camera rhythm to the pair’s timing.

1964422115416768614.title: Ronin walks through broken spears at dusk
1964422115416768614.description: Broken weapons, burning banners, rain and ash create a battlefield aftermath. Rear tracking gives way to an eye close-up, with warm sunset against cold storm clouds.

1955250635529388309.title: Samurai duel escapes an ancient scroll into color
1955250635529388309.description: The scroll unfolds with each step before the fighters leave the paper for full-color animation. Murals, maps or family records could use the same transition structure.

1952004334478037226.title: Two ninjas train in a dojo with red and blue energy
1952004334478037226.description: The prompt reads like art direction, emphasizing decor, palette and energy trails. General martial-arts movement favors performance over a detailed fight.

1951969117897928914.title: Kung fu ducks: second-by-second JSON
1951969117897928914.description: Duration, frame rate, characters, sound and one action per second are structured as JSON. Eight seconds of Veo can follow this clean beat-by-beat framework without overcrowding.

1950836340263723466.title: Kung fu spinning kick: one close-up moment
1950836340263723466.description: A short fighter spins in the air toward a taller opponent’s head, followed by a startled recoil. One action in five seconds is a restrained starting point for earlier models.

1949860456958398844.title: Comic-panel angel vs beast: Midjourney video parameters
1949860456958398844.description: Image-first composition carries the prompt, followed by high-motion and raw video parameters. Gold, grey-white and red define the clash between the angel and the creature.

1946702904896684040.title: Animated factory rivals: handheld impact bounce
1946702904896684040.description: A single sentence asks the camera to bounce with each hit, amid sparks and smashed crates. Hailuo 02 makes this a concise example of selling motion through camera reaction.

1945890431801438546.title: Animated alley duel: camera follows each parry
1945890431801438546.description: Side-to-side camera movement is synchronized with every block. Linking the camera’s rhythm to the exchange gives the fight a clear back-and-forth pattern.

1935098801410158601.title: Roman army charges through snow and torchlight
1935098801410158601.description: Bracketed concepts build the shot from wide angle and low camera to dirty armor, smoke and film texture. Keyword layering is enough to establish the charge’s atmosphere.

1931033884298547362.title: Fast-cut rooftop fight at dusk, with narration
1931033884298547362.description: Five shot cues move from an aerial view to feet, an over-shoulder punch, a detail and a silhouette. Male narration is written directly into the Veo 3 prompt.

1920520421583036431.title: King leads a snowy cavalry charge: four image-to-video models
1920520421583036431.description: One action sentence plus “Dynamic dramatic motion” leaves appearance to the reference image. The four-model comparison illustrates how little text an image-to-video task may need.

1916533364024287363.title: Space ranger vs red spider robot: Luma and Pika
1916533364024287363.description: The same reference and prompt are used for Luma Ray2 and Pika 2.2. Explicitly assigning attacker and defender helps keep both sides active in a monster fight.

1879696405440409618.title: Water and lava warriors clash
1879696405440409618.description: Two elemental fighters, an orbiting camera and bursts of light make up the shortest entry. It is a quick starting point for testing magical combat.

aliyun-wan3-example-01.title: Picking flowers: quiet concentration
aliyun-wan3-example-01.description: Downcast eyes, trembling fingertips and close framing express concentration, with ambient sound carrying the quiet mood.

aliyun-wan3-example-02.title: From singing to a relaxed smile
aliyun-wan3-example-02.description: The emotional change unfolds through finishing the song, removing headphones and smiling, rather than an adjective alone.

aliyun-wan3-example-03.title: Mood direction: a lone, defiant stand
aliyun-wan3-example-03.description: Four shots over fifteen seconds build from restraint to an outburst, with references fixing the general, spear and qilin.

aliyun-wan3-example-04.title: A ballroom smile: extending the opening
aliyun-wan3-example-04.description: The fifteen-second opening extension restates both outfits and the shared smile to connect new footage with the existing clip.

aliyun-wan3-example-05.title: Wong Kar-wai-inspired garden and rain-streaked window
aliyun-wan3-example-05.description: Four timed shots and endpoint frames connect a garden memory to a rainy car window, specifying film texture, light and mood.

aliyun-wan3-example-06.title: Black-and-white wedding: joy turns to shock
aliyun-wan3-example-06.description: A change of events within a train-carriage wedding gives the shift from joy to shock a visible trigger.

aliyun-wan3-example-07.title: Panic on the Huarong Road
aliyun-wan3-example-07.description: A reporter runs toward the camera while handheld movement and background chaos make panic visible.

aliyun-wan3-example-08.title: From a luxury window to a homeless man
aliyun-wan3-example-08.description: A single leftward move reveals the person beside a luxury window, using spatial contrast to change the mood.

aliyun-wan3-example-09.title: Warm light and a growing smile
aliyun-wan3-example-09.description: A medium close-up holds the small change at the mouth, pairing expression with clothing and sunset light.

aliyun-wan3-example-10.title: Stained-glass sidelight and a trace of sadness
aliyun-wan3-example-10.description: Stained-glass sidelight and a small change in the eyes convey sadness without broad gestures.

aliyun-wan3-example-11.title: Lovers’ dialogue: this moment feels like a dream
aliyun-wan3-example-11.description: A two-person medium shot combines shared looks, dialogue and warm stage light so emotion comes through interaction.

aliyun-wan3-example-12.title: Parent and child: I’ll protect you
aliyun-wan3-example-12.description: Moonlight and a bedside lamp establish cool and warm layers before protective dialogue and actions carry the scene.

aliyun-wan3-example-13.title: A surprised look at the door
aliyun-wan3-example-13.description: The short prompt pairs opening a door with the reaction to an unexpected sight, isolating one emotion.

aliyun-wan3-example-14.title: Speaking through tears in high contrast
aliyun-wan3-example-14.description: Lighting and composition are specified alongside tearful speech, giving the close-up a defined visual setting.

aliyun-wan3-example-15.title: Joy over a ripe tomato
aliyun-wan3-example-15.description: A ripe tomato in hand and bright eyes make happiness visible in a very short prompt.

aliyun-wan3-example-16.title: A snowflake smile: extending both ends
aliyun-wan3-example-16.description: Two seconds before and three after the existing clip extend the approach, upward glance and snowflake interaction.
aliyun-wan3-example-16.format: Extend by a few seconds / medium-long shot

aliyun-wan3-example-17.title: Multiple shots: tears and reassurance
aliyun-wan3-example-17.description: Roughly ten seconds of shot blocks move from discouragement toward hope, tying expression to events.

aliyun-wan3-example-18.title: A phone call by the window, with microexpressions
aliyun-wan3-example-18.description: Separate character replacement, voice reference and lip sync, then match blinking, breathing and small nods to dialogue.

2109902576367947891.title: A mermaid wonders why humans wear shoes
2109902576367947891.description: A ten-second vertical close-up builds the question through curious looks and microexpressions rather than large movements.

2109404676466626802.title: The last ocean: shielding water from missiles
2109404676466626802.description: Fifteen seconds of sci-fi action connect a choice to protect the last water source with the impact sequence.

2104507931337400770-2.title: Seoul convenience store: strength in an embrace (part 2)
2104507931337400770-2.description: Part two uses a twenty-second embrace and interaction to continue the emotional arc; both parts share one source video.

2104507931337400770.title: Seoul convenience store: tears and loneliness (part 1)
2104507931337400770.description: Part one establishes loneliness through thirty seconds of performance details; the two prompts remain separate entries.

2104269342275698713.title: My player 2: a farewell high-five that never lands
2104269342275698713.description: The setting is a couch co-op game at home at night; a thirty-second unbroken move and a missed high-five express farewell.
2104269342275698713.format: Short drama, multiple scenes / vertical or landscape

2109845973124210929.title: Bon Voyage: fashion travel through world landmarks
2109845973124210929.description: A fifteen-second square film moves from a collage poster through landmarks, using reference locks and four-panel match cuts; the post compares three models.

2089002238488576059.title: Hoichi the Earless: a live-action ghost story
2089002238488576059.description: The thirty-second 16:9 ghost story establishes the old temple and spectral stage before character and light carry the narrative.

2092106222128574802.title: A woman’s tearful close-up: five seconds of emotion
2092106222128574802.description: A fixed close-up specifies eyes, nose and facial muscle reactions, while excluding smoothing, facial drift and staged acting.

2092662562538352910.title: A Japanese Stand by Me-style 8mm home movie
2092662562538352910.description: One thirty-second take uses imperfect handheld framing, gate weave and faded warm color for a boys’ railway adventure.

2110856254306541796.title: A couple after dark in London’s Soho
2110856254306541796.description: The opening photo fixes both identities, keeps the couple together in every scene and calls for natural skin in night light.

2111461046317715519.title: Morning tour of Almaty
2111461046317715519.description: Six hard-cut scenes over twenty-two seconds lock the first three seconds to the original stairs and background, with no flashes, teleporting or music.

2094056291618676857.title: A breathing megacity after the rain
2094056291618676857.description: A fifteen-second vertical shot builds scale through ground-level movement and a rising road before revealing an opening black-glass structure.

2095088320753893689.title: Tokyo day-trip montage with a Korean idol look
2095088320753893689.description: Thirty seconds are divided into two-second scenes, with REFERENCE LOCK, OUTFIT LOCK and scene-specific night exposure.

2093509473277006226.title: An experimental racer attempts Mach 1 on land
2093509473277006226.description: Escalating speed leads to shockwaves, lift and shedding parts, shown through aerial views and ground-level tire shots.

2091825720657883530.title: Seoul summer home movie (compared with Seedance 2.5)
2091825720657883530.description: Stray hair, tired eyes and imperfect framing create an observed everyday feel; the same prompt is compared with Seedance 2.5.

2102711627972001923.title: One against many on a skyscraper roof
2102711627972001923.description: Separate action choreography from CAMERA CHOREOGRAPHY, using a reference for identity and exclusions for continuity.

2102976373606510839.title: LENS ONE mirrorless-camera commercial
2102976373606510839.description: A thirty-second ad moves from camera-body macro shots into daily life, alternating product detail and human emotion.

2091876549985288529.title: IN RED: a red-dress fashion film
2091876549985288529.description: References and an ARRI Alexa look anchor the red-dress film, with repeated natural-skin and shallow-focus cues.

2102993287359484057.title: A university chemistry demonstration
2102993287359484057.description: The thirty-second teaching scene pairs experiment steps with explanation and camera positions.

2092093843458187735.title: A solo hiker’s expansive journey
2092093843458187735.description: A reference fixes the hiker’s identity while broad landscapes and a travel montage shape the camera rhythm.

2097613778796126569.title: A live-action fighting game on a neon stage
2097613778796126569.description: Realistic performers and a neon stage combine with fighting-game aesthetics; the prompt requests fifteen vertical seconds.

2103433315458097320.title: The last battle under a torii at sunset
2103433315458097320.description: A fifteen-second 16:9 samurai fight combines sunset, practical-looking materials and physical contact.

2091885042293190818.title: Burgundy silk haute couture
2091885042293190818.description: Character references and realistic silk reflections support the couture ad, with explicit fabric and lighting direction.

2095390683100074467.title: Clifftop riding with an immense silk train
2095390683100074467.description: Clifftop riding and an immense train create a surreal fashion contrast, with camera motion following the fabric.

2089899857733616124.title: A cinema hand-holding attempt goes wrong
2089899857733616124.description: The thirty-second vertical scene fixes three rows of seating and left/right relationships before the hand-holding gag.

2100078872440324298.title: A creator is pulled into an open-world game
2100078872440324298.description: A fifteen-second UGC clip connects a real person with a game-world transition while retaining a casual filming feel.

2103863934109512115.title: LUMEN smart-water-bottle commercial
2103863934109512115.description: The thirty-second product film defines the fictional brand and bottle before staging use cases and product coverage.

2093988944392175714.title: Wireless-earbud UGC commercial
2093988944392175714.description: A twenty-second vertical ad locks face shape, hairline and clothes before natural product interactions.

2092737850034753768.title: One sentence: a tearful smiling goodbye (three-model comparison)
2092737850034753768.description: One sentence combines crying, smiling and saying goodbye for a three-model comparison.

2105317512422547606.title: VOLTIS electric-scooter brand commercial
2105317512422547606.description: A fictional scooter brand-film structure connects product presentation with riding scenes.

2101311302841078204.title: A luxury lifestyle product commercial
2101311302841078204.description: A fifteen-second ad organizes the product and lifestyle setting through cinematic shots within a fixed duration.

2106346419363700976.title: A day-at-the-zoo vlog
2106346419363700976.description: The thirty-second vlog uses handheld filming, real skin texture and environmental details instead of polished perfection.

2096108779402355129.title: City travel vlog: snacks and scenic stops
2096108779402355129.description: Four beats over twenty seconds give walking, tasting and sightseeing their own actions and lines.

2099137778386633073.title: Street fight in a narrow rainy alley
2099137778386633073.description: Timed punches, breathing and impact reactions fill fifteen seconds, with wet asphalt, neon and identity exclusions.

2106723741602546165.title: Photo-editing tools invade a real street
2106723741602546165.description: Cursors and selection boxes become physical objects with perspective, shadows and occlusion, supported by consistent light and spatial axes.

2097332722091860172.title: Alexa Grey: behind the scenes of a juice ad
2097332722091860172.description: Identity references outrank storyboard references; thirty seconds retain a spontaneous laugh, an off-camera director and one consistent drink can.

2103426808008057247.title: SIPPO cherry-juice Japanese fashion ad
2103426808008057247.description: The package and four characters are locked separately, while WHIP CUT and MATCH CUT connect surreal Tokyo sets.

2110675197112266833.title: A teal nail-polish beauty ad
2110675197112266833.description: Eighteen short shots over ten seconds lock the model, nails and bottle before macro moves, focus changes and match cuts.

2109161910176485732.title: An FPV flight through Disneyland
2109161910176485732.description: A short prompt chains low passes, dives and tunnels, with material reflections and moving shadows supporting realism.

2100809690850664865.title: Realistic open-world gang gameplay
2100809690850664865.description: Beyond thirty seconds of third-person combat, the prompt separately positions portraits, health bars, objectives and the minimap.

2109516673635999856.title: A smartphone travel vlog in Istanbul
2109516673635999856.description: Selfies, a market visit and a rooftop sunset use handheld drift, autofocus and exposure shifts for a phone-shot feel.

2099352294940709075.title: A dash to an eighties rooftop party
2099352294940709075.description: CHARACTER CONTINUITY fixes the look before the rush across town, with modern vehicles and architecture excluded.

2097253589647310851.title: GTA 6 leak? A beach backflip

anthropic-supported-regions.title: Anthropic’s service regions
anthropic-supported-regions.summary: The policy lists where Anthropic apps, the developer platform and authorized channels are supported; unlisted countries and regions are not supported. It covers use location, organizational registration or headquarters, and ownership or control. The supplied page states an effective date of 2026-11-12; check the official page for applicability.

claude-access.title: Where Claude is available
claude-access.summary: Claude’s help center lists the countries and regions where Claude is available. Use this official list to check your own location.

claude-appeals.title: Claude warnings, suspensions and appeals
claude-appeals.summary: The official page lists repeated policy violations, account creation in unsupported locations and terms violations as possible reasons for suspension. If you believe an account was disabled in error, sign in to that account before opening the appeal form. For a suspended organization, select Request a review for that organization on the restricted-account page.

anthropic-usage-policy.title: Anthropic’s usage policy and enforcement
anthropic-usage-policy.summary: The usage policy covers app users, developers and people using Claude through authorized channels. Suspected violations may result in warnings, restrictions or suspension; a single output stopped by a safeguard does not itself establish a violation. The supplied page states an effective date of 2026-11-12; consult the current official version.

openai-api-regions.title: OpenAI API supported countries and regions
openai-api-regions.summary: This documentation lists the countries and regions supported by the OpenAI API. Accessing or offering access outside that list may lead to an account being blocked or suspended.

gemini-web-regions.title: Gemini web app availability
gemini-web-regions.summary: The official page lists languages, countries and regions supported by the Gemini web app. Mobile app availability may differ, so check the requirements for the product you intend to use.

gemini-api-regions.title: Google AI Studio and Gemini API regions
gemini-api-regions.summary: This page lists countries and regions where Google AI Studio and the Gemini API are available. Access issues with AI Studio may relate to region requirements, being under eighteen or incomplete age verification.
